summary: Implemented the Admin Project Management and Review screens for ADM-12 and ADM-13 using the implemented admin project list and review contracts. The UI uses safe project projections, server-provided availableActions, strict reason validation, locale-aware Arabic/English/Simplified Chinese copy and direction, desktop scope, and loading, empty, error, retry, not-found, success, and permission states.
